name: dorm-store
description: The Dorm Store — orchestrates the frontend (Vite/React store + admin) and backend (Express API) workspaces.

scripts.dev: node scripts/start-dev.js && concurrently --names "store,admin,backend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:store" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
